Updated the savings-bonds Treasury Bulletin skill and compact memory.

Generalizable point saved:
For savings-bond redemption questions involving “elapsed value buildup from original price markdown,” compute:

100 × elapsed value buildup / total redemptions, all series combined

Use the exact month/year row, and don’t confuse this with Series E-only redemptions, sales, unmatured redemptions, or debt/outstanding.
